label: a6-022-lem-uniform-metric-on-a-function-space
tail:
I have read the item and every dependency text provided, testing each proof step and claim against the supplied statements. The main theorem—that \(\bar\rho\) is a metric on \(Y^X\) bounded by \(1\)—is correctly argued from the given dependencies, with no missing hypotheses or invalid inferences. The metric axioms are verified, the use of the least upper bound property is legitimate, and the truncation exactly supplies the necessary boundedness without extra assumptions.

I found no fatal defects. Two remarks contain claims that cannot be verified from the materials supplied, and those are reported below as nonfatal.

### FINDING 1 — NONFATAL — location: Statement (paragraph “Both hypotheses are used…”)
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: “for \(X = \varnothing\) the set \(Y^{X}\) has a single element and \(\sup \varnothing\) does not exist in this library, which has no extended real line ([[rem-sup-conventions]]).”
WHY IT FAILS: The dependency `rem-sup-conventions` is listed but its content was not provided in the audit materials (the supplied text reads only “_(no Statement/Definition section found in this item)_”). Consequently the claim about the behaviour of \(\sup \varnothing\) cannot be verified. The assertion is not used in the proof (the lemma assumes \(X\) nonempty anyway), so it does not affect the theorem’s validity, but if the actual `rem-sup-conventions` page says something different, the item would contain an incorrect aside.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Supply the text of `rem-sup-conventions` so the remark can be checked, or remove the remark if it cannot be substantiated.

### FINDING 2 — NONFATAL — location: Remarks, first bullet
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: “The companion page verifies, on \(C([0,1],\mathbb{R})\), that they are nevertheless uniformly equivalent there and so induce the same topology; no wider claim than that is made here.”
WHY IT FAILS: This reports what an unspecified “companion page” proves. No such page is provided, so the claim is unverifiable from the present dispatch. As noted in the audit instructions, remarks that describe how other items use or relate to the current one are frequent falsehoods when unchecked.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Either include the companion page’s content or rephrase the remark to avoid depending on an external verification that is not in evidence.

**0 fatal, 2 nonfatal**
